meta.subject: bug fixed: CTAsche asid signal not connected to SM

en.summary: The patch fixes missing ASID propagation from the CTA scheduler into the SM dispatch path.
why_it_counts: GPGPU_top.scala now drives that field from cta_sche.io.cu_wf_new(i).bits.asid_kernel when MMU is enabled.
warp_schedule.scala consumes dispatch2cu_knl_asid, so leaving it unconnected breaks per-kernel address-space tracking.
disqualifiers: The commit also updates a test stimulus and a MemBox bundle literal.
evidence: The subject explicitly says CTAsche asid signal not connected to SM.
CTA2warp.scala adds the missing ASID field to the dispatch bundle.
GPGPU_top.scala wires the scheduler ASID into each CTA2warp output.
MemBox.scala adds host_asid to generated metadata.

fault_injection_plan.target_module_or_logic: CTA scheduler to SM ASID dispatch wiring
fault_injection_plan.suggested_edit: Remove the dispatch2cu_knl_asid field or stop assigning it in CTAinterface so the SM-side request carries no kernel ASID.
fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: Warps execute with the wrong address-space tag, causing wrong MMU translation or loss of inter-kernel isolation.
notes: Meaningful only when MMU or address-space tagging is enabled.
fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: With virtual memory enabled, the scheduler must carry a kernel or process ASID into the compute unit so per-warp fetch and translation use the right address space. If that metadata is dropped on the dispatch path, warps inherit a default or stale context.

portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: MMU-enabled execution dispatches wavefronts from kernels with different address-space tags.
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: Remove or neutralize the ASID field on the scheduler-to-execution dispatch interface.
portability_notes: This also applies to VMID, PASID, or other context-ID fields.
If the field already exists structurally, tying it to zero reproduces the same bug.
concrete_injection_steps: Find the bundle that transfers scheduled work into the execution core.
Delete the context-ID field or stop assigning the per-kernel value into it.
Run two kernels with distinct mappings and observe wrong translation context in the receiver.

repository_grounding.target_module_or_logic: CTA scheduler to warp/SM dispatch ASID field and wiring
repository_grounding.commit_fix_summary: The commit adds dispatch2cu_knl_asid to CTAreqData and wires cta_sche.io.cu_wf_new(i).bits.asid_kernel into the CTA2warp outputs.
repository_grounding.source_level_edit_anchor: Either remove dispatch2cu_knl_asid from CTAreqData or stop driving it in CTAinterface/GPGPU_top.

evidence_for_injection: warp_schedule.scala latches dispatch2cu_knl_asid into a per-warp ASID register.
The core fix is hardware bundle definition plus top-level wiring.

zh.summary: 该补丁修复了 CTA 调度器到 SM 分发路径上 ASID 信号未正确传递的问题。
why_it_counts: CTAreqData 新增了 dispatch2cu_knl_asid 字段。
GPGPU_top.scala 现在会在启用 MMU 时把 cta_sche.io.cu_wf_new(i).bits.asid_kernel 驱动到该字段。
warp_schedule.scala 会消费 dispatch2cu_knl_asid，因此未连接会破坏按 kernel 区分的地址空间跟踪。
disqualifiers: 该提交还顺带修改了测试激励和 MemBox bundle literal。
evidence: 提交标题明确写着 CTAsche asid signal not connected to SM。
CTA2warp.scala 在分发 bundle 中新增了缺失的 ASID 字段。
GPGPU_top.scala 把调度器的 ASID 连接到了每个 CTA2warp 输出。
MemBox.scala 在生成的元数据中补上了 host_asid。

fault_injection_plan.target_module_or_logic: CTA 调度器到 SM 的 ASID 分发连线
fault_injection_plan.suggested_edit: 删除 dispatch2cu_knl_asid 字段，或在 CTAinterface 中停止对其赋值，使 SM 侧请求不再携带 kernel ASID。
fault_injection_plan.expected_failure_mode: warp 会带着错误地址空间标签执行，导致 MMU 翻译错误或 kernel 之间隔离失效。
notes: 只在启用 MMU 或地址空间标签时有意义。
fault_injection_plan.portable_bug_context: 启用虚拟内存后，调度器必须把 kernel 或进程 ASID 一直带到计算单元，使每个 warp 的取指和翻译使用正确地址空间。如果这份元数据在分发路径上丢失，warp 就会继承默认或陈旧的上下文。

portable_injection_spec.affected_mechanism: 分发时的 ASID 传递
portable_injection_spec.trigger_condition: 在启用 MMU 的情况下，系统分发来自不同地址空间标签的 wavefront。
portable_injection_spec.injection_action: 删除或失效调度器到执行单元分发接口上的 ASID 字段。
portability_notes: 同类错误也适用于 VMID、PASID 或其他 context-ID 字段。
如果结构上已有该字段，把它绑成 0 也能复现同类错误。
concrete_injection_steps: 找到把已调度工作送入执行核心的 bundle。
删除其中的上下文字段，或保留字段但停止赋真实值。
运行两个地址映射不同的 kernel，观察接收端使用了错误上下文。
